text:
eva: quick sync — we need consolidated inputs from hw partners for the cost model by EOD tomorrow. specifically: reserved tier pricing (1/3/12mo), spot price variance distribution, guaranteed capacity windows, and lead-times for reserved commits. anyone have fresh numbers?

michelle: i pinged the HW partner (NimbleCompute) this morning. they sent a preliminary sheet — want me to paste the key rows here? their contact said spot is unreliable >72h but ok as burst.

raj: paste what you have pls. we need mean+stdev for spot, and whether reserved discounts are backfilled (i.e., does a 12mo commit include swap to newer sku) — that's critical for our depreciation inputs.

michelle: pasted below (copied from partner email):
```
sku,commit_term,unit_type,net_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_mean_usd,spot_sd_usd,guaranteed_hours_per_week,lead_time_days
A100-40GB,1mo,GPU,2.40,0.55,0.15,168,7
A100-40GB,3mo,GPU,1.95,0.50,0.13,168,14
H100-80GB,12mo,GPU,1.60,0.90,0.30,120,30
H100-80GB,1mo,GPU,2.10,1.05,0.40,48,7
```
michelle: they also noted: "reserved swaps allowed at 6mo cadence subject to availability; long-term contracts can include transition credits" — i'll get legal language if this matters.

raj: nice. can you ask for percent of fleet they guarantee for reserved customers vs spot (i.e., what percent of their inventory is earmarked for commitments)? need that to model contention.

michelle: asked — answer expected by EOD. they suggested 65% earmarked for reserved for 12mo customers, 40% for 3mo, rest on spot for day-to-day.

jonathan: for Dedicated planning we need the SLA on preemption for spot-backed pools. if spot preempt rate >5% at peak, our fallback costs skyrocket. michelle, can you get historical preempt rates (weekly) for last 6 months?

michelle: will request. partner already offered aggregated weekly preemption rates and a CSV — expect it tomorrow.

raj: on modeling side i'm going to run two scenarios:
- conservative: spot mean + 1.5*sd, reserved discount baseline as quoted
- aggressive: spot mean + 0.5*sd, assume 12mo reserved swap credit offsets 10% of upgrade cost

marketplace-bot: FYI: cloud marketplace listing for NimbleCompute updated yesterday, SKU mapping: A100-40GB -> nimble-a100-40, H100-80GB -> nimble-h100-80.

eva: good. action items: michelle get fleet % confirmation + weekly preempt CSV, legal confirm swap terms, raj run two scenarios and share a one-pager with per-token cost delta, jonathan list fallback cost (per-hour) for +10% preempt. i'll collate and send to finance before partner call on Fri. :thumbsup:

michelle: noted, will follow up in thread when I have the CSV.

raj: i'll start the notebook now (link -> drive:gs://redwood-partners/cost-models/nimble-initial.ipynb). expect draft by EOD.

jonathan: tagging infra-oncall to eyeball fallback ops: @infra-oncall please advise if we can tolerate 10% spike without service impact.

eva: thanks all — sticking this in the prep doc for the Fri call.
